footnotes: From pre-tax income to net loss to SmartStop Self Storage REIT: after $7.0M attributable to noncontrolling interests. No per-share figures were reported for these years. The filing reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 18.6% to $281M in 2025. Gross margin was 61.3%, versus 65.7% a year earlier, and operating income fell 14.6% to $59.1M, a 21.0% margin.

The net loss narrowed to $8.8M, or $0.00 per share, from $18.4M. Operating cash flow was $85.0M and free cash flow $85.0M, versus $64.0M; SmartStop Self Storage REIT returned $74.8M through dividends.
